name: DeepSeek
note: Quota only, and a balance rather than a meter: DeepSeek is pay-per-use and publishes no cap, so there is no percentage to report. One row per currency the account holds — the currency is read from the response rather than assumed, because Chinese accounts are billed in CNY and labelling that with a dollar sign would misstate the balance by an exchange rate. Set quota.credential to {"kind":"textFile","path":"~/.<name>-key"} or paste the key straight into this file. The environment variable works too, but only when Antarium is launched from a shell — an app started from Finder inherits no environment.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live account.

quota.setupHint: Add your API key to deepseek.json.
